steps.check: A hand is holding the top edge of the open laptop lid.
steps.coach: Put your hand on the top edge of the screen.
steps.failure: The lid cannot be pulled down without a grip on its top edge.
steps.instruction: Reach out and grab the top edge of the laptop lid.

steps.check: The laptop lid is closed flat against the base and the screen is not visible.
steps.coach: Keep pulling the lid down until it rests on the keyboard.
steps.failure: A half-closed lid leaves the screen on and the hinge under strain.
steps.instruction: Pull the lid toward you and close it fully shut.
